gpu_tip: ~53GB total at 128K context. An i-quant: strong quality per byte at 3-bit, at the cost of more CPU work per token, so it runs best on CUDA/ROCm with as many layers on the GPU as fit. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060) plus a 64GB DDR5 kit runs it via expert offloading.
mac_tip: Needs ~53GB — tight on a 64GB MacBook Pro (M4 Max or M5 Max); a 96GB config leaves headroom.
